title: Voidsurf, a test ground.
author: JoonasOfficial
selftext:
Introducing a project that I'm actually considering abandoning unless I can find a way to make it more unique. I've seen quite a few similar projects pop up recently, and I think it needs something more to stand out.

Still curious to hear people's feedback and see if there's any interest or engagement. And if nothing else, I figured I'd leave a development trail for the internet's great archive...

I have other projects in the works, some already further along than this one, but I wanted to share this as a reasonably complete gameplay loop. It features different enemy types (not particularly well-balanced), power-ups, a final boss (also not particularly well-balanced), and of course the pretty neat shader effect for the surface. It's essentially a baseline that could be refined and expanded upon. But I think a project like this needs something genuinely unique to justify further development.

I work in the game industry, but I have practically zero coding experience. I've been experimenting with generative AI technologies for the past three years, and my background is primarily on the visual and creative side. I spent over a decade working as a freelance illustrator and have also been involved in a few gaming startups.

I'm incredibly inspired by the possibility of bringing this kind of interactivity into my projects. Being able to move beyond my traditional skill set and to push beyond my comfort zone creating things I previously wouldn't even have attempted on my own. 

Done with Codex (Astra really helped to refine the 3D space as a coherent environment), Claude, Blender MCP, etc.
